title: Exercise 3: A Function-Calling Stress Test
description: A starter hint that defines a three-parameter tool in a system prompt and lists ten queries: five that should call the tool and five that should not.

steps.description: `SYSTEM` is the system prompt. It gives the model one tool and the rules for using it.

The tool is `search_database`. It takes three parameters: `query` (required), `limit` (required, 1 to 20), and `filter_category` (optional). The exercise asks for one optional parameter, and this is it.
The prompt sets the output rule: for product questions, respond only with a JSON tool call; for other questions, respond normally in plain text.
`tool_queries` holds five queries that should trigger the tool, each tagged with the comment `should call tool`. They are all product searches.
`non_tool_queries` holds five general questions, each tagged `should NOT call tool`. They need no database search, so the model should answer in plain text.

steps.question: The exercise says a good function-calling model should score what range on the ten queries?
